title: Kocatepe Mosque
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Kocatepe Mosque and mapped raised platform: windowed main dome/four cascading semi-domes/corner caps, four three-balcony minarets, open pointed courtyard with low basin,side loggia/raised doors and stairs,mapped eastern annex and open Bankacı tunnel passage. Nine raw current map controls and two tagged tunnel centre-lines retained. Main vertical partitions,curved roofs,arcade/bay counts,unmapped small details,annex function and precise ground joins remain estimates. Six existing shared graphs,seven merged roles,four browser levels. Current finish,temporary courtyard cover,fine artwork,basement shops and unseen interiors remain limited.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained exact OSM relation6276462 / Q853935 is the current standard viewer whole52776564409710 with its open courtyard. Current platform35184794287588 has a5m height tag; hall/dome parts and four circular minaret parts provide separate controls. The small eastern hexagonal annex is retained as a mapped ancillary mass with unverified function. All nine current controls and raw properties remain unchanged. PositiveX follows the main prayer hall toward SSE,negativeX the NNW courtyard,and positiveZ the WSW public side loggia. Original anchor/heading retained;no horizontal rescale. Current map tags omit QID on the tile geometry,so relation ID continuity and retained exact identity remain distinct from tile properties.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: The retained identity has no linked height/width/length facts. The lower platform5m tag is retained separately from all estimated architectural heights. Picture-proportioned exterior: hall walls15m; main dome drum31.5–37m with11.5m cap and1.5m finial; four cascading large/small semi-domes,corner caps/buttress turrets; four minarets with three balconies and estimated88.9m tips. Courtyard arcades/roof domes,side loggia,door/step positions,low courtyard basin/caged cap,eastern annex,parapets and fine profiles are estimates. The courtyard picture shows temporary overhead construction framing;it is omitted and present cover/finish remain unverified. Inscriptions,fine stonework,lattice,interiors,basement shops and exact engineering are not reconstructed.

geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: Standard viewer DEM datum907.8431686498072m. Platform/court plane2.483275388141692m is the median of256 outside-perimeter samples every3m at1m offset plus the mapped5m platform height. Raw platform samples range-8.47059724090093..4.2058253506558m. The foundation follows raw boundary heights;the preview seats terrain under the mapped platform. Two tagged Bankacı tunnel centre-lines retain raw geometry;7m carriageway widths and4.8m clearance are visualization estimates. The tunnel floor follows the retained DEM,with open side portals and no replacement of host roads. This approximates a raised terrace on a coarse hillside DEM;exact road thresholds,stairs,retaining heights and street joins remain unverified.
